funder.name: Gifu Prefecture, Forest Utilization Promotion Division

summary: Grants to groups and companies based in Gifu Prefecture for their own forest-building, river-building, water-environment and biodiversity conservation activities, paid from the prefecture's Forest and Environment Tax. About 50 projects in this round; outreach and children's activities are also eligible.

amount.note: Costs up to 500k yen funded in full, costs above that at one half
